renderer.prompt: Create a path-traced macro product photograph of one bounded handcrafted Project Orchestrator museum diorama. Use a joined timber shadow box, layered cotton card, visible corrugated cuts, linen seams, cork inclusions, paper fibers, hand-shaped clay figures, scratched brass, stitched fabric routing, and hand-cut acrylic. Center a wood-and-brass routing wheel in front of exactly 47 paper skill folios. Place repository intent at a staffed drafting bench on the left, a human-operated approval gate in the foreground, a glass-front validation and evidence workshop on the right, and a finished governed workspace at the route endpoint. Use warm directional museum light, cool reflected fill, contact shadows, cast shadows, physical occlusion, moderate macro depth of field, and controlled handmade imperfections. Integrate only the title, Repository Intent, 47 Governed Skills, Human Approval, Validate + Record, Governed Workspace, one takeaway, source attribution, exact signature, and current Eastern date as physical exhibit plaques. Do not use flat UI cards, glossy generic icons, floating labels, a tall routing tower, clouds, logos, dashboards, invented metrics, extra identities, or deployment claims.
